verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a first-party Dynadot MCP server at /domain/mcp that lets an AI assistant check domain availability, register domains, view domains and account info, and review nameservers and DNS records. The probe confirms an official MCP page exists. Missing for 10: connection/setup and authentication details, transport/client compatibility documentation, broader tool coverage (e.g., DNS edits rather than review only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
